name: Overlord Ramtusk
summary: Overlord Ramtusk is a massive quilboar warlord who leads the warriors deep within Razorfen Kraul. Crying out for victory and for Agamaggan, he fights at the head of his elite guards, and striking him down shatters the martial backbone of the Kraul's defenders.

sections.title: Warlord of the Kraul
sections.body: Overlord Ramtusk holds command deep within the thorny maze of Razorfen Kraul, the quilboar stronghold in the southern Barrens. He goes into battle with a war cry to the boar demigod Agamaggan, and he rules the Kraul's fighters with unyielding authority.

sections.title: Commander of the Kraul
sections.body: Within the winding brambles of the Kraul, Ramtusk directs the quilboar warriors. As their warlord, he maintains tight discipline among the bristled fighters defending the tribe's sanctum. Flanked by elite marksmen, Ramtusk fights like a frontline berserker, bellowing rallying shouts and unleashing earth-shattering slams that can break opposing battle lines in seconds.

faq.answer: Overlord Ramtusk is a quilboar warlord who commands warriors deep within Razorfen Kraul. He is a massive, imposing fighter who goes into battle crying out for victory and for Agamaggan.

faq.q: Where can Overlord Ramtusk be found?
faq.answer: He commands his elite guards from within the thorny heart of Razorfen Kraul, located at the southern tip of the Barrens.

faq.q: What enemies has Ramtusk fought in the past?
faq.answer: Nothing records his past battles. In the Kraul he fights at the head of his elite guards, crying out for victory and for Agamaggan against any outsider who breaches the briars.

faq.q: What tribe does Ramtusk belong to?
faq.answer: He is one of the Razorfen quilboar who hold the thorny stronghold of Razorfen Kraul in the southern Barrens and revere the boar demigod Agamaggan.

faq.q: Why is Ramtusk targeted by adventurers?
faq.answer: As the warlord leading the Kraul's warriors, Ramtusk's death deals a crippling blow to the quilboar military hierarchy, throwing their defensive line into complete disarray.
Ramtusk fights as a classic battle-hardened warrior, using demoralizing cries to empower his cohort, crushing shockwaves to stagger enemies, and coordinating alongside elite ranged bodyguards.

angles.text: For generations, the nomadic tribes of the Barrens fought bitter skirmishes against the quilboar of the Kraul; putting him down avenges fallen braves.
The quilboar have actively raided Horde settlements since the founding of Durotar and the Barrens outposts. Breaking Ramtusk's military command secures the southern Barrens.
Ramtusk represents pure, brutal martial veteranhood, relying on thunderous strikes and commanding battle shouts rather than shamans' geomancy or thorn magic.
